results.content:
And here’s why it matters.

The new Economist/YouGov poll has Democrats leading the House vote among likely voters:

Democrats 49%  
Republicans 38%

D+11.

But this is NOT your typical generic-ballot poll.

As election analyst G. Elliott Morris pointed out this morning, YouGov asked voters using the NAMES OF THE ACTUAL CANDIDATES RUNNING IN THEIR DISTRICT.
